[{"insert":"Suitcase Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat
 
The suitcase rear foot elevated split squat is the main single leg strength work on Fridays. A dumbbell hanging at each side keeps the torso upright and drives almost all the load onto the front leg while the back foot only balances. Keep the front heel planted and lower for two seconds on every rep. Reps step down from twelve to ten to eight per side as the weight climbs each set.
"}]
